title: NexHub 2.0.0 正式版
body: NexHub 2.0.0 正式版来了！经过 beta.1 → beta.8 八轮打磨，基础功能完整、可安全升级：底层与三大阅读器、RSS 订阅、网络配置、源解析能力都已充分验证。本次正式版相较 beta.8 还新增了「源声明式图片字节解密 imageTransform」（部分图床对图片字节本身加密，现在源可在 imageTransform 段声明解密方式，引擎统一解密，支持 aes-cbc/aes-ecb/rc4/xor 等）、章节页 Referer 推导取图、图片收藏本地缓存、通用渲染与图片兼容增强、抓取层 JSON 协商、Cookie 轮换站点图片修复、启动回填本地封面崩溃修复。沿用同一签名密钥，可直接覆盖安装。另外想跟大家说一声：过去两三个月我几乎每天高强度开发（常一天十小时以上），现在有点累了，想先休息一段时间；NexHub 不会停更，后续我仍会持续维护（修 bug、保稳定），只是功能上可能不会有大的新增，节奏会慢一些。感谢一路的陪伴。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0 (stable) is here! After eight beta rounds (beta.1 → beta.8), the foundation is solid and safe to upgrade: the engine, the three readers, RSS, network config and source parsing are all well exercised. Compared to beta.8, this stable build also adds source-declared image-byte decryption (imageTransform — for CDNs that encrypt the image bytes themselves, sources can now declare the decryption in an imageTransform block and the engine decrypts uniformly, supporting aes-cbc/aes-ecb/rc4/xor), Referer-derived image fetch on chapter pages, local caching for image favorites, broader rendering/image compatibility, JSON negotiation in the fetch layer, a fix for image-flip-flopping on cookie-rotation sites, and a startup crash fix when restoring local covers. Same signing key — just overwrite-install. A note from the author: after two to three months of near-daily, high-intensity development (often ten-plus hours a day), I'm a bit tired and want to take a break for a while. NexHub is not abandoned — I'll keep maintaining it (bug fixes, stability), but feature growth may slow down for a bit. Thanks for all the company along the way.

A note from the author: after two to three months of near-daily, high-intensity development (often ten-plus hours a day), I'm a bit tired and want to take a break for a while. NexHub is not abandoned — I'll keep maintaining it (bug fixes, stability), but feature growth may slow down for a bit. Thanks for all the company along the way.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.7 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.7 预发布测试版来了！本次是一次小而关键的修复：解决「应用内更新提示下载完成、装上的却是旧版本安装包」的问题——现在安装包按版本号分目录存放，旧残留不会再冒充新包；复用本地包前会先校验文件完整性，旧版本残留也会自动清理。如果你之前遇到过「明明更新了，版本号却没变」，这一版请手动下载安装一次，之后的应用内更新就恢复正常了。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.7 (pre-release beta) is here! A small but critical fix: resolves 'in-app update says download complete but installs the old package' — installers are now stored in per-version folders so stale files can no longer pose as the new package; local files are integrity-checked before reuse, and leftovers from previous versions are cleaned up automatically. If you ever updated but the version number didn't change, please manually install this one — after that, in-app updates work normally again. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.6 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.6 预发布测试版来了！本次把 RSS 订阅从「一个简单的列表」升级为完整的阅读模块：离线缓存（含正文，断网可读）+ 全文抓取、已读置灰与跨源收藏页、分组管理与 OPML 导入导出、输入网址自动发现订阅、单源与全局跨源搜索；文章里图片可点开进画廊缩放保存，视频直接内嵌播放（手势 / 锁屏 / 比例 / 进度记忆与主播放器一致），带音频的播客源可直接播放。还修好了图片 403 加载失败、音频显示 0:00、抓取超时、内嵌视频偶发连不上等实机问题，并支持条件 GET 省流量、非 UTF-8 订阅不再乱码，DNS 解析出多个 IP 时逐个重试（修复「浏览器能开、应用超时」）。更新提醒新增系统通知开关与充电时自动检测。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.6 (pre-release beta) is here! RSS subscription grows from a simple list into a full reading module: offline caching (full text included, readable without network) + full-text fetch, read-state dimming and a cross-source favorites page, group management with OPML import/export, feed auto-discovery from a site URL, and per-feed plus global cross-feed search. Images in articles open into a pannable/zoomable gallery with save and share, videos play inline (gestures / control lock / aspect ratio / progress memory, matching the main player), and podcast feeds with audio enclosures play right on the article page. Real-device fixes land too: image 403 failures, audio showing 0:00, fetch timeouts and flaky inline video. Conditional GET saves traffic, non-UTF-8 feeds no longer garble, and DNS results with multiple IPs are tried in order (fixing 'browser opens it, app times out'). Update reminders gain a system-notification toggle and a while-charging check. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.5 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.5 预发布测试版来了！本次集中修复网络收藏的多文件夹体验与源网络档案覆盖范围：网络收藏现在能正确切换文件夹、两级导航（文件夹→作品）不再卡死，文件夹卡片还显示条目数；评论、标签浏览、收藏列表三处现在也会正确应用你在源里配置的 SNI / 钉 IP / 自定义 DNS，之前这些页面因没走源网络配置而连不上的问题已修复。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.5 (pre-release beta) is here! This release fixes the multi-folder web-favorite experience and broadens source network-profile coverage: web favorites now switch folders correctly and the two-level navigation (folders → items) no longer gets stuck, and folder cards show item counts; comments, tag browsing and favorite lists now correctly apply the SNI / pinned-IP / custom-DNS you configured in the source — the connection failures on those pages are fixed. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.4 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.4 预发布测试版来了！本次重点打磨跨语言翻译的可靠性与可用性：翻译接口主备容灾 + 健康熔断，章节翻译支持断点续译，术语表注入让专有名词翻译一致，可选润色与证据审校，译文可一键导出复用；漫画页翻译气泡回填更准、视频整片字幕离线翻译可导出双语字幕。同时加固网络连通性（同站串行防限流、网络收藏修复、Cookie 登录归一化）、收藏（详情页可收藏 + 图片收藏持久化）、下载与更新通道，并默认隐藏 18+ 源、全应用补齐触感反馈。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.4 (pre-release beta) is here! This release hardens cross-language translation reliability and usability: primary/backup translation endpoints with a health circuit breaker, resumable chapter translation via checkpoints, glossary injection for consistent terms, optional polish and evidence-driven review, and one-tap export of reusable translations; manga page-translation bubbles backfill more accurately and whole-video offline subtitle translation can export bilingual subtitles. Network connectivity is further hardened (per-host serialization to avoid rate-limiting, web-favorite fixes, normalized cookie login), favorites (detail-page favorite + image-favorite persistence), download and update channels, plus 18+ sources hidden by default and haptic feedback app-wide. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.3 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.3 预发布测试版来了！本次重点带来两大跨语言阅读能力：漫画页翻译（翻页自动对当前页做 OCR + 翻译，译文按版面叠加、按作品记忆、失败可重试）与视频字幕实时翻译（字幕面板开关逐句翻译、无字幕时截帧画面 OCR 兜底、译文覆盖层可选显示原文）。同时修复了更新通道——测试版通道现在能正确识别新版本，并支持 alpha / beta / rc 预发布逐级升级；大幅增强网络连通性：运行时 SNI 控制（免 SNI 绕封锁）、DNS 解析后缀（社区源不含 IP）、源级网络覆盖自动沿用、无头抓取接入 Cloudflare 验证与直连 TLS / 端口修复；源解析能力增强：路由占位符偏移 {page-1}/{page+1}、meta 批量预取、分类键名容错。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.3 (pre-release beta) is here! Two cross-language reading capabilities headline this release: manga page translation (auto OCR + translate on page-turn, layout-overlaid bubbles, per-work memory, retry on failure) and real-time video subtitle translation (per-sentence panel toggle, frame OCR fallback when no subtitle, optional original overlay). The update channel is fixed — the beta channel now detects new versions and supports alpha / beta / rc pre-release upgrades; network connectivity is greatly improved with runtime SNI control (SNI-free to bypass blocking), DNS resolve suffixes (no IPs in community sources), auto-inherited source network overrides, headless Cloudflare handling and direct TLS / port fixes; source parsing is enhanced with route placeholder offsets {page-1}/{page+1}, meta batch prefetch and category key tolerance. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.2 预发布测试版
body: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.2 预发布测试版来了！在 beta.1 基础上继续打磨三大阅读器：小说阅读器新增双页模式、整本页码、AI 双语 / 段落翻译、AI 章节配图、阅读器内正文编辑、墨水屏主题、压缩包批量导入、Mobi / PDF 解析、阅读进度 WebDAV 云同步、EPUB 导出模板、划线 / 高亮 / 摘录 / 分享；漫画阅读器新增夜览暖色盖层、睡眠定时、资源内存优化、双击三态、E-Ink 刷新、ICC 校色、预加载 1–16；影视播放器新增 Anime4K 超分辨率、弹幕发送、缓存降级、错误重试、字幕记忆、系统画中画与投屏完整生命周期；还有跨作品待读队列、统一图片收藏图库、源 API Key 登录与 WebView 登录 + Cookie 回灌、Cloudflare 验证修复，以及大量实机修复。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.2 (pre-release beta) is here! Building on beta.1, the three readers are further polished: the novel reader gains dual-page mode, whole-book page numbers, AI bilingual / paragraph translation, AI chapter illustration, in-reader text editing, e-ink theme, batch archive import, Mobi / PDF parsing, fine-grained WebDAV reading-progress sync, EPUB export templates, and highlight / annotate / share; the manga reader adds night-light overlay, sleep timer, resource & memory optimization, double-tap 3-state, E-Ink refresh, ICC color, and 1–16 preload; the video player adds Anime4K super-resolution, danmaku sending, cache degrade, error retry, subtitle memory, and full system-PiP / cast lifecycle; plus a cross-work reading queue, unified image gallery, source API-Key login with WebView login + cookie injection, Cloudflare fix, and many real-device fixes. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 2.0.0-beta.1 预发布测试版
body: 2.0.0 预发布测试版来了！底层升级到 Flutter 3.47；小说阅读器新增 Legado（阅读）书源导入兼容、书内搜索跳命中、阅读总结、音量键 / 滚轮翻页、TXT 内部章节细化、进度恢复修正、GBK 乱码修复；漫画阅读器新增书签、图片收藏、自然排序、自动下载、缩放倍数指示等大批实机修复；影视播放器新增多源自动选源 + 故障回退、跨作品播放队列、后台播放 + 通知栏、画中画、跳过片头片尾、自动连播倒计时、睡眠按集数、双击 seek 累加、底部细进度条、弹幕去重、本地视频封面、横滑取消手势等。这是 beta 测试版，可能有个别 bug，欢迎升级并反馈。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖安装。
bodyEn: The 2.0.0 pre-release beta is here! Flutter upgraded to 3.47; the novel reader gains Legado (阅读) source import, in-book search jump, reading summary, volume-key / wheel page-turn, TXT chapter splitting, progress-restore fix and GBK mojibake fix; the manga reader adds bookmarks, image collection, natural sort, auto-download, zoom-ratio indicator and many real-device fixes; the video player adds multi-source auto-select with failover, cross-work play queue, background playback + notification, PiP, intro/outro skip, auto-next countdown, sleep-by-episodes, double-tap seek accumulation, bottom thin progress bar, danmaku dedupe, local video cover and swipe-cancel gesture. This is a beta — some bugs may remain; upgrade and report issues. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 1.2.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：重点修复本地内容（下载 / 导入）稳定性——Android SAF 下载写入、本地下载视频 / 漫画 / 小说打开、下载落盘丢失章节等问题；三大阅读器体验增强（小说大文件加载提速、EPUB 章节解析更准）；新增「运行日志」（设置 → 高级）便于反馈排障。无破坏性数据变更，可直接覆盖升级。
bodyEn: This update focuses on local content (download / import) stability: Android SAF write, opening locally downloaded video / manga / novel, and lost chapters on download are fixed; the three readers are improved (faster large-file loading, more accurate EPUB chapter splitting); a new Run Log (Settings → Advanced) makes bug reports easier. No breaking data changes — just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 1.1.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：新增本地内容导入体系——小说支持 TXT / EPUB，漫画支持 PDF / CBR / RAR / 7Z 等归档与整文件夹导入（Android 支持 SAF 文件夹）；设置搜索升级为 226 项全覆盖、直达具体设置项。无破坏性数据变更，旧数据与源 JSON 无需重新导入，可直接覆盖升级。
bodyEn: This update adds a full local content import pipeline: novels in TXT / EPUB, manga from PDF, CBR, RAR, 7Z archives or whole folders (Android SAF supported), plus a settings search that covers all 226 entries and jumps straight to the exact setting. No breaking data changes — your data and source JSON need no re-import; just overwrite-install.

title: NexHub 1.0.0 发布说明
body: 本次更新：首次启动 6 步新手引导、软件公告系统、Bangumi OAuth 登录重写修复（授权返回不再卡死转圈）。基础功能已完成，数据格式保持兼容，可放心升级。应用不内置任何站点，内容来自你导入的源。
bodyEn: This update: a 6-step onboarding guide, an in-app announcement system, and a rewritten Bangumi OAuth login (no more stuck spinner on return). Core features are complete and data stays compatible — safe to upgrade. The app ships no built-in sites; content comes from the sources you import.

title: NexHub 0.5.1 发布
body: 本次更新：软件公告与首次启动引导、Bangumi 登录改用内置浏览器、语言默认跟随系统。应用不内置任何站点，内容来自你导入的源。
bodyEn: This update: in-app announcements and first-launch onboarding, Bangumi sign-in now uses an embedded browser, and language defaults to following the system. The app ships no built-in sites; content comes from the sources you import.

title: 欢迎使用 NexHub
body: NexHub 是四合一媒体聚合客户端（动漫 / 漫画 / 小说 / 影视）。它不内置任何站点，解析能力全部来自可导入的「源」。导入社区维护的源后即可开始浏览。
bodyEn: NexHub is an all-in-one media client (anime / manga / novel / video). It ships no built-in sites; all parsing comes from importable 'sources'. Import a community-maintained source to start browsing.
